items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: What made me want to play the trumpet was when I heard Louis Armstrong playing "The St. Louis Blues"... It just drove me crazy to hear that. I used to just sit and listen to it all night.

ctx.x: Yeah, before him. What made me want to play the trumpet was when I heard Louis Armstrong playing "The St. Louis Blues" with Bessie Smith.

items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...You had the Louis Armstrong-Bessie Smith recording of 'St. Louis Blues.' Did you ever play that for him? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: What kind of stuff was Lester listening to? Did he have any records at that time, in 1924, from April to November? You had the Louis Armstrong-Bessie Smith recording of "St. Louis Blues." Did you ever play that for him?
